answer_1.quote: The seven tasks are closed-book question answering (CBQA), coreference resolution, natural language inference (NLI), abstract summarization, multi-lingual translation, reading comprehension, and text classification.
answer_1.outputs: The model generates outputs for summarization and translation tasks as part of the downstream evaluations.

answer_2.quote: We utilize the opencompass framework to run the evaluation process on the aforementioned tasks.
